messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@acmehealth.com>, Tom Burns <tom@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps - pilot burn rate / credits

Thanks again for taking the time today - great discussion. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery call so we have alignment:

- Goal: Evaluate Redwood for clinical note summarization in Acme's provider portal (low latency inference for 1:Many sessions).
- Current pilot: 1-week sandbox with 100k total tokens of Redwood credits (provisioned last week).
- Observed burn: approx ~220k tokens/day during peak testing (range 150k-250k).
- Key ask from Acme: extend pilot credits and confirm unit economics to evaluate full rollout decision.

Pricing / unit economics we discussed (examples to validate):
- Target unit cost: $X / 1M tokens (we discussed target $120 / 1M tokens as threshold for their budget).
- Estimated monthly usage at scale (prod candidate): 60M-120M tokens (depends on feature set / caching).

Proposed next steps:
1) Samantha/Tom: confirm expected peak daily tokens for next 2 weeks of pilot and whether test traffic will stay consistent with today's patterns (action: confirm numbers).
2) Acme: request for a +2 week credits extension to fully exercise multi-day behavior (action: reply with official ask).
3) Rishi/Neha: internal approval for credits extension and quick sanity check on proposed unit economics (action: internal approval).

Samantha - if you confirm the expected token consumption window, I can request a temporary credits extension (we typically do 7-14 day extensions for pilots) and include the estimated unit cost so your finance/ops folks can evaluate.

Attached: pilot_usage_summary.csv (stub), example pricing calc (inline below).

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference
(415) 555-0198

---
Attachment: pilot_usage_summary.csv (CSV stub - headers: date, tokens_used)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Cc: Tom Burns <tom@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps - pilot burn rate / credits

Thanks Marissa - useful recap. Quick answers:

- Confirmed burn: during our daytime testing window (8am-6pm PT) we're seeing ~180k tokens/day average, spikes to ~240k on concurrent sessions. Overnight is near zero.
- For the next 2 weeks we'll keep a similar test profile; we plan one load test next Fri where we might hit 300k tokens in a single day for ~2 hours.
- We'd like a +14 day extension to the credits so we can run the load test and evaluate caching effects across multiple days.

If you can confirm an estimated unit cost to put in front of our procurement (we need a benchmark $/1M tokens), that would be great. We discussed $120 / 1M tokens as the target - can you confirm Redwood can hit that for pilot volumes (and what that implies for committed pricing later)?

Thanks,
Samantha
Sr. Product Manager, Acme Health
samantha@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha@acmehealth.com>, Tom Burns <tom@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Credits extension request - Acme Health pilot (need approval)

Rishi / Neha -

Acme is asking for a +14 day extension on their pilot credits to validate load test behavior. Current pilot is 100k tokens but their observed burn is ~180k/day (spikes to 300k). They want to run for another 14 days to capture multi-day caches and peak tests.

Key asks for approval:
- Provide an additional 2M tokens of credits (covers up to ~14 days at current burn with buffer).
- Share an estimated unit cost to the customer for evaluation: we mentioned $120 / 1M tokens as target. For pilot/POC we can confirm indicative pricing but reserve final committed pricing for contract stage.

Notes:
- Related deal: DEAL-ACME-2026-03 (HubSpot link below).
- Risk: if we give too many free credits upfront, we set a high expectation. Recommended 2M token extension as a measured compromise.

Can you approve the 2M token extension and greenlight sharing the $120 / 1M tokens indicative number with Acme? If approved I'll send the confirmation and attach the approval stub.

Thanks - Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Credits extension request - Acme Health pilot (need approval)

Marissa - thanks for the context. Approving 2M token extension for Acme's pilot (timebox: 14 days). Please note: this is a one-time pilot grant, approval recorded on the deal.

On unit economics: $120 / 1M tokens is reasonable for pilot/POC at these volumes; call it indicative pricing. If they move to committed Reserved capacity (monthly) we can discuss tiered pricing and commit discounts - likely lower effective $/1M once we have a committed token/throughput contract.

Action: Marissa - please confirm the exact extension window start/end and send the attached approval PDF to Samantha/Tom. Also ask them to fill the short intake form (link) so procurement has the usage footprint for contract stage.

Rishi
VP, Sales Operations

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>

Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps - pilot burn rate / credits (approved)

Hi Samantha / Tom -

Good news: Rishi approved a one-time extension of 2,000,000 tokens for Acme's pilot. Extension window: 2026-03-25 through 2026-04-07 (14 days).

What this means:
- We've added 2M tokens of Redwood credits to your pilot account effective now. That should cover the planned load test and multi-day behavior capture.
- Indicative unit cost for evaluation: $120 / 1M tokens (pilot/POC only). Final production pricing depends on committed volumes or Dedicated capacity.

Attached: redwood-pilot-credits-approval.pdf (approval stub). Please confirm you received the credits and that your load test still planned for next Fri. Also, can you fill this short intake form so procurement has the usage profile: https://crm.hubspot.com/form/acme-pilot-intake

Thanks everyone - excited to see results from the load test.

Best,
Marissa Cole
